_meta.purpose: Named contrast scenarios for theme-creator.html's advisory readout. One row per real foreground/background pairing a token participates in, not one row per token -- several tokens serve more than one role.
_meta.confidence: high = read directly against a rule in css/rux.css, cited by line. medium = the token's role is clear but the exact paired surface was not confirmed against rendered markup. low = a real approximation stands in for something css/rux.css does not express as a solid color (e.g. a translucent overlay). medium and low entries need a second read before this catalogue is trusted for shipping, per roadmap Phase 14.
_meta.fixedSurfaces: Names prefixed 'fixed:' are not among the twenty editable tokens -- they are Carbon's own tokens this tool does not change (text-on-color, text-inverse, text-primary, background, layer, background-inverse), included so a scenario can name what it actually sits against.
